annotation.title_clean: Responsible AI #AIFORALL: Approach Document for India, Part 1 – Principles for Responsible AI
annotation.title_en: Responsible AI #AIFORALL: Approach Document for India, Part 1 – Principles for Responsible AI
annotation.summary_en: NITI Aayog's 2021 approach document sets seven principles for responsible AI in India, derived from constitutional rights. It analyses system considerations (explainability, bias, exclusion, accountability, privacy, security) and societal ones (jobs, profiling), reviews legal and technology-based approaches, and includes a self-assessment guide. Embodied AI appears only in passing, such as autonomous vehicle attacks.
key_provisions_or_claims: Seven principles: safety and reliability, equality, inclusivity and non-discrimination, privacy and security, transparency, accountability, and reinforcement of positive human values
Principles are grounded in the Indian Constitution and its fundamental rights
Considers narrow AI only, split into system and societal considerations
Recommends technology-based tools such as model cards and datasheets for transparency
Part 2 will address operationalisation across public sector, private sector and academia
